title: Smart Data Models - Brick Schema - ZoneAirTemperatureSensor
description: A temperature sensor for the air within an HVAC zone -- one specific member of Brick's broader Temperature_Sensor family (which also includes e.g. Outside_Air_Temperature_Sensor, Discharge_Air_Temperature_Sensor). Modeled as its own class here because this is the exact leaf class in the real example data (a thermostat's zone sensor); the other family members share the same property shape and could be added the same way. A dedicated schema for this specific Brick Point leaf class (brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor, hierarchy: Air_Temperature_Sensor -> Temperature_Sensor -> Sensor -> Point), alongside the generic Point entity this candidate also publishes. NOTE: the source ontology names this class 'Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor' (Brick uses underscore-separated Title_Case); the NGSI-LD entity type here is 'ZoneAirTemperatureSensor', renamed to strict PascalCase per this repository's naming convention (no underscores, no dots -- 'Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor' contains both). hasQuantity and hasSubstance are fixed (const) here because they are definitional for this exact class, not a per-instance choice.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ZoneAirTemperatureSensor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable label (rdfs:label in the source).

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isPointOf.description: Relationship. The Equipment or Location this point belongs to (brick:isPointOf). May be absent when the relationship is only asserted from the Equipment side (brick:hasPoint) and left for a reasoner to materialize the inverse -- real in the source data (see the thermostat's Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor).

hasUnit.description: Relationship. The unit of measurement, as a QUDT unit concept URI (brick:hasUnit). Not fixed at the class level -- different deployments of the same sensor type may report in different units.

hasQuantity.description: Relationship. Temperature (QUDT quantitykind:Temperature -- note Brick references QUDT directly here rather than a Brick-native Quantity individual). Fixed for this class.

hasSubstance.description: Relationship. The air within an HVAC zone specifically, not air in general (brick:Zone_Air). Fixed for this class.

hasAssociatedTag.description: Relationship. Brick's tag-based classification for this class (brick:hasAssociatedTag). The tags declared on this class in the source ontology are: Air, Point, Sensor, Temperature, Zone.

aggregate.description: Property. How the point's raw data is reduced before storage (brick:aggregate).

aggregationFunction.description: Property. E.g. 'mean' (brick:aggregationFunction), constrained to exactly these 7 values per the source ontology's bsh:AggregationShape SHACL definition.

resolution.description: Property. The smallest change in value the point's sensor can distinguish (brick:resolution).

hasExternalReference.description: Property. A pointer to where this point's actual time-series data is stored (ref:hasExternalReference).

hasTimeseriesId.description: Property. Opaque identifier of the timeseries (ref:hasTimeseriesId).

storedAt.description: Property. Connection string / location of the timeseries store (ref:storedAt).
